data.case_title: Water damage ceiling drying – appointment with Trocknungstechnik Beispiel
data.title: Schedule drying of your bathroom ceiling after water damage
data.summary: Verwaltung Musterhof GmbH writes that after a pipe burst (Rohrbruch) in the apartment above yours, the building insurer's expert found that your bathroom ceiling must be technically dried. You are asked to arrange an appointment with the drying company Trocknungstechnik Beispiel within 5 business days of the letter's date.
data.explanation: Your property management needs you to contact the drying company (Trocknungstechnik Beispiel) by phone and agree on a date for them to dry your bathroom ceiling, which was damaged by a pipe burst in the apartment above. You should call them by the deadline shown. If you don't get in touch in time, the management will fix an appointment on your behalf without asking you first, which could mean a date that doesn't suit you. No payment is requested from you in this letter.

items.title: Arrange appointment with Trocknungstechnik Beispiel
items.action: Call Trocknungstechnik Beispiel (phone 0541 22 11 00) to agree on a date for drying your bathroom ceiling.
items.consequence: If you don't respond in time, the property management will set the appointment without consulting you.
items.quote: Bitte vereinbaren Sie binnen 5 Arbeitstagen ab Briefdatum einen Termin mit der Firma Trocknungstechnik Beispiel (Telefon 0541 22 11 00); Arbeitstage sind Montag bis Freitag, gesetzliche Feiertage ausgenommen.
